ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels dominate approximately 85-90% of the visible surface, with low-intensity black pixels restricted to the peripheral margins and specific internal markings.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central macro-region is solid high-intensity white. Dark pigmentation (low intensity) is localized to the trailing and leading edges. Notable interior features include a vertical linear dark streak on the left lobe and a small focal dark spot on the upper distal quadrant of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch, estimated internal angle of 40-45 degrees with a vertical depth of approximately 18% of the fluke's visible height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous, irregular jagged serration along the trailing edge. Frequency is high across both lobes, with pixel-amplitude of peaks varying between 4 to 12 pixels relative to the edge baseline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobes exhibit an outward sweep with a slightly concave leading edge and a predominantly convex trailing edge curve, tapering into narrow, pointed tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast white punctate clusters (3-5 distinct points) situated within the distal black pigmentation of the left fluke tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent vertical dark linear mark approximately 1/3 distance from the left tip; several faint, horizontally-aligned pixel disruptions on the right lobe white field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct vertical linear pigmentation disruption on the left lobe; focal dark circular point on the distal right lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Irregular feathered transition zone where the black trailing edge pigmentation interdigitates with the interior white field, particularly visible on the inner trailing edge of the left lobe.
